title: HR Manager - Temporary to Permanent
description:
HR Manager - Temporary to Permanent Opportunity

Location: Merseyside
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Hours: 37 hours per week
Start: Immediate
Contract: Temporary, with the potential to become permanent

Tradewind Recruitment are currently recruiting for an experienced HR Manager to join a multi-school Trust in Merseyside on a temporary basis, with the potential for the role to become permanent.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HR professional who is looking for a varied and responsible role supporting staff across multiple school sites. Previous experience working within education is not essential; candidates with a strong HR background from other sectors are encouraged to apply.

The successful HR Manager will work closely with senior leaders and the Trust's HR team, providing professional HR advice and guidance across a range of employee-related matters.

Key Responsibilities

As HR Manager, you will be responsible for:
- Managing recruitment, selection and induction processes across the Trust.
- Providing HR advice and guidance to managers and staff.
- Managing employee relations and case management, including complex and sensitive cases.
- Supporting and advising on absence and sickness management.
- Providing guidance on employment policies, procedures and employment law.
- Supporting performance management and staff development.
- Managing and maintaining accurate HR records and documentation.
- Working closely with senior leaders and school management teams.
- Liaising with external HR providers and professional services where required.
- Supporting staff wellbeing and engagement.
- Ensuring HR processes are managed professionally, confidentially and in line with relevant legislation.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will have:
- Minimum CIPD Level 5 qualification.
- At least 10 years' experience working within HR.
- Strong experience in employee relations and case management.
- Excellent knowledge of HR policies, procedures and employment law.
- Experience managing recruitment processes.
- Strong experience dealing with sickness and absence management.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- The ability to work independently, prioritise workloads and manage sensitive information confidentially.
- A professional, approachable and adaptable manner.
- A full driving licence and access to a car, as the role will involve travelling between different schools within the Trust.

A school/education background is not essential for this position. The Trust is looking for an experienced HR professional who can bring strong HR knowledge, sound judgement and excellent employee relations skills to the role.

Working Hours

The role is 37 hours per week, with some flexibility around the school day for the right candidate.

The successful applicant will be required to travel between schools within the Trust, so access to your own vehicle is essential.

Why Apply?
- Immediate start available.
- Temporary position with potential to become permanent.
- Opportunity to work across a well-established multi-school Trust.
- Varied and senior HR responsibilities.
- Flexible approach to working hours.
- Excellent opportunity for an experienced HR professional to make a real impact across multiple schools.

How to Apply

If you are an experienced HR Manager with a minimum of CIPD Level 5 and 10 years' HR experience, and you are available to start as soon as possible, we would love to hear from you.

For more information or to apply, please contact Lizzie McDonnell at Tradewind Recruitment on (phone number removed) or email (url removed).

BC Financial Search is delighted to be recruiting for a Credit Controller to join a highly regarded, independent professional services business based in Liverpool city centre.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and successful business with a strong reputation across the North West and a genuine commitment to developing and supporting its people.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the finance function, ensuring outstanding payments are managed effectively whilst maintaining positive relationships with clients and colleagues.

Offering a competitive salary of £25,000-£30,000, hybrid working and an attractive benefits package, this position would suit an experienced Credit Controller looking for their next opportunity within a friendly and professional environment.

Duties and responsibilities

- Managing outstanding invoices and proactively following up overdue payments.

- Building and maintaining positive working relationships with clients to support timely payments.
- Handling payment queries and resolving discrepancies efficiently and professionally.
- Preparing and issuing customer statements and payment reminders.
- Liaising with colleagues across the business regarding outstanding invoices and account queries.

Experience and qualifications

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller or similar finance position.

- Good organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when maintaining financial records.
- A proactive and approachable attitude towards resolving queries.
- Good IT skills, including Excel and experience using accounting or finance systems.
- The ability to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider team.

Previous experience within a professional services environment would be advantageous, although candidates from other industry backgrounds are also encouraged to apply.

Benefits

This opportunity offers an attractive benefits package alongside the chance to join a respected and established professional services business that places considerable importance on its people, culture and development.

Benefits include:
- Competitive salary of £25,000-£30,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working, offering flexibility between home and the Liverpool city centre office.
- Generous annual leave, with the option to purchase additional holiday.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Healthcare benefits, including access to Medicash.
- Group life assurance.
- Enhanced parental leave.
- Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
- A supportive, collaborative working environment within a well-established business.

Company culture

Our client is a highly regarded, independent professional services business with an established presence across the North West.

Despite its size and reputation, the business remains focused on providing a personal service to its clients and creating a supportive, inclusive environment for its employees.

The company places a strong emphasis on teamwork, professional development and building lasting relationships, making this an attractive opportunity for someone who values stability, flexibility and being part of a successful local business.

For an experienced Credit Controller seeking a new challenge within a professional and welcoming environment, this could be an excellent next step.

Please apply with your CV or contact Ben Copsey at BC Financial Search directly for a confidential discussion.
